■Direction
Stay away from me!!

No... It's just as I feared. Taishin...
You really should reconsider staying in the racing world like this.
Hah... Hah...!!

The massive pile of food laid across the table beside them.
If all of that was meant for Narita Taishin alone, it was indeed far too much...

Shut up, just shut UP!!
For my sake? Ha, don't give me that crap!!
Hmm. But with that build of hers—

Challenging the Twinkle Series with a body like that is reckless.
Something irreversible could happen to you.

...It's going to be tough for her to contest positioning, as expected.
The size difference puts her at far too much of a disadvantage.
And after the race—

...She burned through far too much energy early on.
Such reckless running... It's painful to watch...
DAMMIT ALLLLLL!!
...Shut up.

What radiated from her painfully desperate stride
was a deeply piercing—impatience.

Ngh! It's nothing.
...What do you want?

The cafeteria at midday. An outburst violently unfitting
the peaceful mood of the bustling Umamusume brought an instant hush over the room.

...Hmph.
I'll show them... Today, for sure...!

Now, now, we won't know anything for sure until we see her run.
Well then, it's almost post time...!
Sorry, I didn't notice you there...!

Whoa, there's a remarkably tiny girl out there, huh?
...Though today's Debut Selection Race doesn't really have any standout stars.

Whoa, I thought that petite girl was going to trail from behind, but she's pushing to the front!
Is she trying to muscle her way into the battle for position...?!
Ticket has a point this time, Taishin.
Hah... Hah... Hah...!!
...Huh?
T-Taishin... But, but, I just...!!

Haaah... Haaah...!!
Ngh, grrrk...!!

Spitting those words out, Narita Taishin dashed away.
The cornered look on her face burned itself into my mind...

The one running on the track was that petite Umamusume from the cafeteria earlier—
Narita Taishin.

Girls from prestigious bloodlines or those brimming with raw potential
always carry a distinctly different aura about them, after all.

Hah, hah... Ugh, ngh—
...Aaaaaaarrrgh!!

Having entered the golden "Peak Condition" where their racing abilities shine brightest,
the Umamusume brim with drive, eager to show the fruits of their training. Amidst them...

Taishin-san! Please, I'm saying this for your own good.
Just hear me out—!!

Before that happens... give up on this path.
Even for an Umamusume, there are other ways to live than running, right?

...Among the girls who would soon be making their debuts,
there stood Narita Taishin, looking as though she might be buried in the crowd at any moment.

Just listen to me. You already have a small appetite to begin with.
Just the other day after eating, your face turned—

While sufficient nutrition is essential for physical growth,
what you're doing is taking it too far. It borders on overeating.
Dammit...!!
...Shut up.

Man, she keeps getting shoved around...
There's no way her stamina's gonna hold out like that, right?

—Taishin-san, about... Oh, are you alright?
You still haven't caught your breath...?

—What?
You trying to say anything a runt does is pointless!?

I'm gonna win with these legs. I'll definitely win.
And I'm gonna shove it in your face, too...!
Whoa!!

...Stop following me around.
Just leave me alone...!!

On my way home after working late into the night,
I happen to stop by the training course—

There was no denying the brilliant sharpness of her final burst. But in the end,
Narita Taishin gradually slipped back—finishing in 10th place.

It was the night after
witnessing that deeply unsettling scene.
I said shut up!!

A sudden silence... followed by a stir.
Drawing the bewildered gazes of all the Umamusume was—

*pant*... *pant*... Dammit.
...My head hurts...
—An Umamusume so petite and fragile, it took my breath away.

And now, every runner is in the gate—
and they're off!!

Whoa-whoa-whoa, wait, wait, wait!! You've got it wrong, Taishiiin!!
That's not what I meant at all...!!

Now the leader rounds the fourth corner!
Making their move here is—

Gritting her teeth, Narita Taishin tears across
the course with a cry like spitting blood.

A few days later... the day of the "Debut Selection Race,"
where Umamusume show their abilities to the trainers.

Narita Taishin! An incredible closing burst from Narita Taishin!!
She shoots straight to the lead!!
Haaah...!!
